import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Convention
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Machine-construction library: wrappers

The output-isolation layer of the machine-construction library
(`machine-library-design.md` §5, W1–W3): the capture/silence discipline
written once, consolidating its four private incarnations
(`universalCaptureTM` in the universal-machine development, the Chapter-2
enumerator's `enumCaptureTM`, the HALT batch's `acceptTM`, and the private
engine inside `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition.exists_cond`).
The obligation list is the one the phase-1 and phase-4 audits tabulated:
every source emission is captured, **including an emission on the halting
transition**; the wrapper's physical output stays untouched; the completed
source configuration is preserved at the return.

**Status: proved.** The two action/configuration transformers and the
derived machine are real definitions; the four contract theorems are
proved (filled from the existing private proofs in the library fill
batches; gates closed). New Chapter-1 surface, audited in the shared
infrastructure round.

## Design

* **W1 (capture)** is *host-parametric*: rather than a closed wrapper
  machine, `Turing.captureAction` transforms one source action into a host
  action (source tapes untouched, emission appended to the last tape,
  silence, halt redirected to a designated return state), and
  `Turing.capture_run` says that **any** host machine agreeing with the
  transformed table on an embedded copy of the source states simulates the
  source in lockstep with its output captured on the last tape. Consumers
  (the loop fill, HALT-style control modifications, the Chapter-2
  continuations) embed the source into *their* controller state type and
  inherit the whole induction. The capture tape holds the full output
  word (tape-capture core, frozen design decision 9.3); reading one bit
  off it is the register corollary, derived at fill time.
* **W2 (halt-redirect)** is the `acceptTM` pattern as a closed
  transformation `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM`: simulate a machine silently
  while remembering the last emitted bit, halt exactly when the source
  halts with the designated bit, and otherwise enter a one-state
  stationary live loop.
* **W3 (timed branch)** is the quantitative form of
  `Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_partial`'s sibling
  `Turing.FinTM.exists_cond`: deciding which branch runs costs the
  decider's budget, and the branch runs on the *same* physical input, so
  no monotonicity hypothesis is needed.

## Main declarations

* `Turing.captureAction`, `Turing.captureCfg` — the W1 transformers.
* `Turing.capture_run` — the W1 lockstep/capture/silence contract.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM` — the W2 transformation.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_computes`, `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_live` — the
  W2 contract pair.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_runFrom` — the W2 run correspondence, field by field (MIG-1).
* `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM` — the W3 controller (MIG-1, the named witness), with
  `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_computes` (time) and `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_spaceUsed`
  (space), both sorried until the fill F-A.
* `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond` — the W3 timed branch.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2; the capture discipline is the
  output-isolation folklore every simulation argument of §1.4–§1.7 uses.)

**Implementation note (batch W).** All four contracts are now proved; the
original spec-phase descriptions above and in their docstrings are retained.
The conditional controller instantiates `capture_run` on a padded decider,
reads its singleton output, and uses a quantitative refinement of
`rewind_from_any`. Its branch-start prefix is at most twice the decider's
budget plus five, yielding the uniform multiplier `5` in the frozen bound.

**Maintainer note (D6 promotion).** Batch W's two shared-lemma promotion
requests are executed: `timed_input_bound` is now the public
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound` in `Deterministic.lean` (generalized
from `Bool` to an arbitrary symbol type; the proof was symbol-free), and
`timed_rewind` is the public `Turing.FinTM.timed_rewind` in
`Simulation.lean`, verbatim. The private copies formerly here are removed;
the two call sites below consume the public lemmas.

**Implementation note (emitter batch W).** `emit_run` is now proved by the
private action identity `emit_apply` and the guarded induction used by
`capture_run`. A halting action forwards its optional final emission on
the same transition that transfers control to the live return state.
-/

namespace Turing

variable {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*}

/-- W1 action transformer. Transform one source action into a host action
over one extra tape: the source's input move and work-tape actions are kept
on the first `k` tapes; the source's emission, **if any**, is written on
the last tape with a right move (so the capture tape accumulates the output
word from the origin); the host emits nothing; a live source successor is
embedded via `emb`, and a halting source action transfers control to the
designated return state `ret` — on the very transition that may carry the
final emission, which is therefore captured like any other. -/
def captureAction (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    Action (k + 1) Bool H where
  inputTape := a.inputTape
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then a.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
    else
      match a.output with
      | some b => (some (some b), SignType.pos)
      | none => (none, SignType.zero)
  output := none
  state := some ((a.state.map emb).getD ret)

/-- W1 configuration correspondence. A source configuration `c`, viewed
inside a host with one extra tape: source state embedded (a halted source
sits at the return state `ret`), same input head, source work tapes on the
first `k` tapes, and the capture tape holding `pre ++ c.output` — the
emissions captured so far after a pre-existing prefix — with its head one
past that word. The host's own physical output is the untouched `out₀`. -/
def captureCfg {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) :
    Cfg (k + 1) Bool H input where
  state := some ((c.state.map emb).getD ret)
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then c.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
    else FinTM.bufferTape (pre ++ c.output)
  workTapePos := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then c.workTapePos ⟨i, h⟩
    else ((pre ++ c.output).length : ℤ)
  output := out₀


section Gate117NewSection4
attribute [local irreducible] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed Turing.FinTM.bufferTape
attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg
-- Field equations for the captured source configuration.
attribute [simps (config := { isSimp := false }) state inputPos workTapes workTapePos output]
  Turing.captureCfg


end Gate117NewSection4
attribute [simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg
/-- Applying a captured action preserves the source fields and appends its
optional emission to the buffer. The write uses the old head before moving.
**Proof sketch.** Split the tape index at the source tape count. Source tapes
are unchanged by the embedding; on the final tape use `bufferTape_append`
for an emission and the stationary no-write action otherwise. -/
private lemma capture_apply {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    (captureAction emb ret a).apply (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c) =
      captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (a.apply c) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ ?_
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi]
    · cases ho : a.output <;>
        simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi, ho,
          ← List.append_assoc, FinTM.bufferTape_append]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi]
    · cases ho : a.output <;>
        simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi, ho, Nat.cast_add,
          add_assoc]
  · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply]

/-- **W1, the capture contract** (harvested from the
four private incarnations). If a host machine's transition table agrees, on
an embedded copy of the source's states, with the capture-transformed
source table, then the host run from a capture configuration *is* the
capture image of the source run, for as long as the source has not halted
before the time in question. Taking `t` to be the source's halting time
instantiates the return clause: the host sits at `ret` with the completed
source configuration preserved, the full source output (halting emission
included) on the capture tape, and the host output still `out₀`; taking
`t` below it gives live lockstep.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `t`. One host step from a live capture image
applies the transformed action: the first `k` tapes and the input head
update exactly as the source's (`Turing.Action.apply` componentwise); the
capture tape appends the emitted bit, which is
`Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append` at head `|pre ++ c.output|`; silence keeps
the host output at `out₀`; and the successor state is the embedded source
successor, or `ret` on the halting transition. -/
theorem capture_run {input : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w =
        captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc))
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t =
      captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (tm.runFrom c₀ t) := by
  have hstep (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (hs : ¬c.Halted) :
      host.step (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c) =
        captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (tm.step c) := by
    cases hq : c.state with
    | none => exact False.elim (hs hq)
    | some q =>
      have hstate : (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).state = some (emb q) := by
        simp [captureCfg, hq]
      have hinput : (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
      have hwork : (fun i => (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).workTapeSymbols
          i.castSucc) = c.workTapeSymbols := by
        funext i
        simp [captureCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, i.isLt]
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hq]
      rw [hagree, hinput, hwork]
      exact capture_apply emb ret pre out₀ c _
  -- The guard supplies a genuine source step, including at the final halt.
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (fun s hs => hlive s (by omega)),
      hstep _ (hlive t (by omega)), MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

/-- **E2 action transformer** (design §11): the forwarding dual
of `Turing.captureAction`. Transform one source action into a host action
over the **same** tapes: input move and work-tape actions are kept
verbatim; the source's emission, **if any, is forwarded as the host's
physical emission** — including an emission on the halting transition; a
live source successor is embedded via `emb`, and a halting source action
transfers control to the designated live return state `ret`. This is what
lets a proved transducer serve as one emission stage of a larger host.
Customers: the forwarding loop-host variant behind `exists_emitLoopTM`,
and `exists_emitCallTM`'s module. Construction: a record map, no
machine content. -/
def emitAction (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    Action k Bool H where
  inputTape := a.inputTape
  workTapes := a.workTapes
  output := a.output
  state := some ((a.state.map emb).getD ret)

/-- **E2 configuration correspondence** (design §11): a source
configuration `c`, viewed inside the host — state embedded (a halted source
appears at the live return state `ret`), tapes, heads, and input position
verbatim, and the host's physical output equal to the host's prior output
`pre` followed by everything the source has emitted. It deliberately does
**not** normalize the source's terminal tapes or heads: clean returns are
the separate bridge contracts' job (`exists_installCallTM`,
`exists_emitCallTM` — emitter-infra round-1 audit, finding 1). Customers:
`emit_run`'s statement and the bridge fills. Construction: a record map,
no machine content. -/
def emitCfg {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) :
    Cfg k Bool H input where
  state := some ((c.state.map emb).getD ret)
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := c.workTapes
  workTapePos := c.workTapePos
  output := pre ++ c.output

/-- Applying a forwarded action preserves the source fields and appends its
optional emission after the host prefix, including when that action halts.
**Proof sketch.** The state, input head, work tapes, and work heads agree
definitionally; the physical output equality is append associativity. -/
private lemma emit_apply {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    (emitAction emb ret a).apply (emitCfg emb ret pre c) =
      emitCfg emb ret pre (a.apply c) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_
  exact List.append_assoc pre c.output a.output.toList

/-- **E2, the forwarding wrapper** (design §11;
customers: the emitting loop's per-round chunk calls, the Cook-Levin
clause-group emission (4A), 3B-cont's fresh-literal chains). Any host
machine agreeing with the transformed table on an embedded copy of the
source states runs the source in lockstep while **appending the source's
output to the host's physical output**, the exact dual of
`Turing.capture_run`: source tapes verbatim, the halting transition's
emission forwarded like any other, and the host landing in the live
return state at the source's halt.

**Construction sketch.** Mirror `capture_run`: one `emitAction`-apply
lemma (source fields preserved; the optional emission appended to the
host output after `pre`), then induction over the guarded run, the guard
supplying a genuine source step including at the final halt. -/
theorem emit_run {input : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin k → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w = emitAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp w))
    (pre : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (emitCfg emb ret pre c₀) t =
      emitCfg emb ret pre (tm.runFrom c₀ t) := by
  have hstep (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (hs : ¬c.Halted) :
      host.step (emitCfg emb ret pre c) =
        emitCfg emb ret pre (tm.step c) := by
    cases hq : c.state with
    | none => exact False.elim (hs hq)
    | some q =>
      have hstate : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).state = some (emb q) := by
        simp [emitCfg, hq]
      have hinput : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
      have hwork : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := rfl
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hq]
      rw [hagree, hinput, hwork]
      exact emit_apply emb ret pre c _
  -- The guard supplies a genuine source step, including at the final halt.
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (fun s hs => hlive s (by omega)),
      hstep _ (hlive t (by omega)), MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

end Turing

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- W2 transformation: the `acceptTM` control-modification pattern. Simulate
`M` with its output suppressed while a finite register remembers the **last**
emitted bit (`none` before any emission) — updated *before* the halt test, so
a bit emitted on the halting transition counts. When the source halts, halt
if the remembered bit is `haltOn`; otherwise enter the one-state stationary
live loop. Tape count unchanged. -/
def redirectTM (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := M.k
  State := (M.State × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit
  tm :=
    { q₀ := Sum.inl (M.tm.q₀, none)
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        match q with
        | Sum.inl (s, r) =>
          let a := M.tm.tr s inp work
          let r' := match a.output with
            | some b => some b
            | none => r
          { inputTape := a.inputTape
            workTapes := a.workTapes
            output := none
            state := match a.state with
              | some s' => some (Sum.inl (s', r'))
              | none => if r' = some haltOn then none else some (Sum.inr ()) }
        | Sum.inr () =>
          { inputTape := SignType.zero
            workTapes := fun _ => (none, SignType.zero)
            output := none
            state := some (Sum.inr ()) } }

/-- Map a source state and its last-emission register to simulation, halt,
or the stationary live loop. An empty register never matches a bit. -/
private def redirectState {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool) (q : Option S)
    (r : Option Bool) : Option ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  match q with
  | some s => some (.inl (s, r))
  | none => if r = some haltOn then none else some (.inr ())

/-- Suppress physical emission, updating the register before the halt test. -/
private def redirectAction {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool)
    (a : Action k Bool S) (r : Option Bool) : Action k Bool ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, none, redirectState haltOn a.state (a.output.or r)⟩

/-- The source tapes and input head are unchanged; its last emitted bit is
remembered in control and the physical output is empty. -/
private def redirectCfg (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool
      (redirectTM M haltOn).State x :=
  ⟨redirectState haltOn c.state c.output.getLast?, c.inputPos,
    c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, []⟩

/-- The stationary live loop is fixed by every subsequent transition. -/
private lemma redirect_loop (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool (redirectTM M haltOn).State x)
    (hs : c.state = some (.inr ())) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom c t = c := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [MultiTapeTM.step, hs, redirectTM, Action.apply]

/-- Capture and application commute because the last entry of an appended
singleton is the new bit, while no emission leaves the old register intact. -/
private lemma redirect_apply (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : Action M.k Bool M.State) :
    (redirectAction haltOn a c.output.getLast?).apply (redirectCfg M haltOn c) =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (a.apply c) := by
  have hlast : (c.output ++ a.output.toList).getLast? = a.output.or c.output.getLast? := by
    cases a.output <;> simp
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ rfl rfl rfl rfl
  dsimp only [redirectCfg, redirectAction, Action.apply]
  rw [hlast]

/-- The correspondence also holds after a source halt: a matching result
is absorbed as halted, and a mismatching result is absorbed in the live loop.
This adapts `acceptCfg_step` in the HALT reduction to an optional register. -/
private lemma redirect_step (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.step (redirectCfg M haltOn c) =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.step c) := by
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hs]
    by_cases hr : c.output.getLast? = some haltOn
    · exact MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt (by simp [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs, hr])
    · exact redirect_loop M haltOn (redirectCfg M haltOn c)
        (by simp [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs, hr]) 1
  | some q =>
    have hi : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
    have hw : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := rfl
    have hstate : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).state = some (.inl (q, c.output.getLast?)) := by
      simp only [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hs]
    rw [hi, hw]
    have htr : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.tr (.inl (q, c.output.getLast?))
        c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols =
        redirectAction haltOn (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c.output.getLast? := by
      cases hq : (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state <;>
        cases ho : (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output <;>
          simp [redirectTM, redirectAction, redirectState, hq, ho]
    rw [htr]
    exact redirect_apply M haltOn c _

/-- Initialized runs commute with redirection at every time, including
after a source halt. This is the last-emission invariant for both clauses. -/
private lemma redirect_run (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t) := by
  have hi : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x = redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.initCfg x) := rfl
  rw [hi]
  exact MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (redirectCfg M haltOn) (redirect_step M haltOn)
    (M.tm.initCfg x) t

/-- **W2, the halting clause** (harvested from the
HALT batch's `acceptTM_halts_iff`). If `M` completes output `w` on `x`
within `t` steps and the last bit of `w` is the designated bit, the
redirected machine halts on `x` within the same budget with **empty**
output (everything was suppressed).

**Proof sketch.** Lockstep correspondence between `M`'s run and the
redirected run, carrying "register = last emitted bit so far"; at `M`'s
halting transition the register equals `w`'s last bit, so the redirect
halts there. -/
theorem redirectTM_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? = some haltOn) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).ComputesInTime x [] t := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hout⟩ := (computesInTime_iff M x w t).mp hM
  apply (computesInTime_iff _ x [] t).mpr
  rw [redirect_run]
  exact ⟨by simp only [redirectCfg, hs, hout, redirectState, hlast, ite_true], rfl⟩

/-- **W2, the live clause**. If `M` completes output
`w` on `x` and `w`'s last bit is *not* the designated bit (in particular if
`w = []`), the redirected machine never halts on `x`: at the source's
halting transition it enters the stationary live loop, which is fixed under
every further step.

**Proof sketch.** Lockstep with the register invariant (register = last
emission so far) up to the source's halting transition; there the register
differs from the designated bit, so control enters the stationary live
state, which every further step fixes (two-line induction). -/
theorem redirectTM_live {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? ≠ some haltOn) :
    ∀ u : ℕ, ¬((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) u).Halted := by
  intro u hhalt
  rw [redirect_run] at hhalt
  change redirectState haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state
    (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).output.getLast? = none at hhalt
  -- A redirected halt forces a genuine source halt with the matching register.
  have hs : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state = none := by
    cases h : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state with
    | none => rfl
    | some q => simp only [redirectState, h, reduceCtorEq] at hhalt
  have hc : M.ComputesInTime x (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).output u :=
    (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩
  have hout := hc.output_unique hM
  rw [hs, hout] at hhalt
  simp only [redirectState, if_neg hlast, Option.some_ne_none] at hhalt

/-- **The redirect correspondence**. At every time `t`, the redirected machine's configuration on
`x` has the source run's input position, work tapes and work heads, an empty output, and the state
that the source state and the source's last emitted bit determine: the source state with that bit
while the source is live; after the source halts, halted if the bit is `haltOn`, and the stationary
live loop otherwise.

**Proof sketch.** Rewrite with the private `redirect_run`, which states that the run is the
image of the source run under the private `redirectCfg`; each conjunct is then a field of that
image, by `rfl`. -/
theorem redirectTM_runFrom (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).state =
        (match (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state with
          | some s => some (.inl (s, (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast?))
          | none =>
            if (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast? = some haltOn then none
            else some (.inr ())) ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).output = [] := by
  rw [redirect_run]
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  generalize M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t = c
  rcases c with ⟨q, p, tapes, heads, out⟩
  cases q <;> rfl

/-- Pad the decider with the fresh branch tapes. The added tapes are idle,
so the public left-block simulation supplies its complete run invariant. -/
private def timedPadTM (D : FinTM Bool) (r : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (D.k + r) Bool D.State where
  q₀ := D.tm.q₀
  tr q inp work := leftAction r id (D.tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd r i)))

/-- **The timed conditional**. Run the decider `D` with its output captured on the last tape, step
back to read the verdict, rewind the input, then run `M₁` or `M₂`, as the verdict says, from its
genuine initial configuration on its own untouched tape bank (W3). The branch tapes are idle while
`D` runs. -/
def timedCondTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) + 1
  State := D.State ⊕ (Bool ⊕ ((Bool × Bool) ⊕ (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State)))
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl D.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work => match q with
        | .inl q => captureAction Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false))
            ((timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)).tr q inp (fun i => work i.castSucc))
        | .inr (.inl false) =>
          ⟨0, (fun i => if (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k) then (none, 0)
            else (none, .neg)), none, some (.inr (.inl true))⟩
        | .inr (.inl true) => controlAction 0
            (some (.inr (.inr (.inl ((work (Fin.last _)).getD false, false)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, false))) =>
            controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))) => match inp with
          | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
          | none => controlAction .pos
              (some (.inr (.inr (.inr (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inr q)) => leftAction 1 id
            (rightAction D.k (fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s)))
              ((branchTM M₁ M₂ false).tm.tr q inp
                (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc))) }

/-- The branch configuration retains the decider's finished work and the
captured verdict; its own state, input head, work tapes, and output are exact. -/
private def timedBranchCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  leftCfg id (rightCfg (fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s))) c tapes heads)
    (fun (_ : Fin 1) => bufferTape [b]) (fun _ => 0)

/-- The decider's configuration inside its padded, captured simulation.
Both branch tape banks are blank throughout this phase. -/
private def timedControlCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  captureCfg Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false)) [] []
    (leftCfg id c (fun (_ : Fin (M₁.k + M₂.k)) _ => none) (fun _ => 0))

/-- The capture contract, instantiated on the padded decider, gives the
entire controller phase through its first halt. -/
private lemma timed_capture (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ s < t, ¬(D.tm.runFrom c s).Halted) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) t =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom c t) := by
  have hpad (u : ℕ) := leftCfg_run D.tm (timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)) id
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) c (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) u
  have h := capture_run (timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)) (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm
    Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) [] []
    (leftCfg id c (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)) t (fun s hs => by
      unfold Cfg.Halted
      rw [hpad s]
      simpa only [leftCfg, Option.map_id] using hlive s hs)
  simpa only [hpad t] using h

/-- The host's genuine initial configuration is the captured, padded
initial configuration: all three work-tape blocks are blank. -/
private lemma timed_control_init (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.initCfg x) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)
    · simp only [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
        Cfg.init, dif_pos hi]
      exact (Fin.addCases (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ => by simp) ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hi]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)
    · simp only [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
        Cfg.init, dif_pos hi]
      exact (Fin.addCases (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ => by simp) ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hi]

/-- Once dispatched, the selected branch runs in lockstep while the old
decider tapes and singleton capture tape remain idle.
**Proof sketch.** The branch action is a right-block embedding followed by
a left-block embedding; compose their application lemmas, then iterate. -/
private lemma timed_branch_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b) t =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads b := by
  apply MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (fun c => timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b)
  intro d
  cases hs : d.state with
  | none =>
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, hs, Option.map_none]
  | some q =>
    have hstate : (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).state =
        some (.inr (.inr (.inr q))) := by
      simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, hs, Option.map_some, id_eq]
    have hi : (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).inputSymbol = d.inputSymbol := rfl
    have hw : (fun i => (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc) = d.workTapeSymbols := by
      funext i
      simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
        Fin.castSucc, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hs]
    dsimp only [timedCondTM]
    let emb : (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) → (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State :=
      fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s))
    change (leftAction 1 id (rightAction D.k emb
      ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.tr q d.inputSymbol
        (fun i => (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).workTapeSymbols
          (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc)))).apply
        (leftCfg id (rightCfg emb d tapes heads)
          (fun (_ : Fin 1) => bufferTape [b]) (fun _ => 0)) = _
    erw [hw, leftCfg_apply, rightCfg_apply]
    rfl

/-- After reading the verdict, all branch data are initialized; only the
input head still needs rewinding. The capture head is back at cell zero. -/
private def timedReadyCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  { timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b with
    state := some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, false))))
    inputPos := c.inputPos }

/-- Two silent transitions move the capture head left and read the completed
singleton verdict, without touching the input or either work bank.
**Proof sketch.** The final capture head is one past the singleton, hence at
one. Moving it left exposes exactly its bit at zero; the next transition
records that bit in the rewind state. -/
private lemma timed_read (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) 2 =
      timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b := by
  let ready := timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b
  have hback : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) =
      {ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} := by
    have hstate : (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).state = some (.inr (.inl false)) := by
      simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hs]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) ?_ ?_ rfl
    · funext i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, j.isLt]
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro z <;> simp
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, ho]
    · funext i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, j.isLt]
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro z <;> simp
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, ho]
  have hread : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step
      {ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} = ready := by
    have hsym : ({ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} :
        Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.last _) = some b := by
      change (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)
        c.workTapes c.workTapePos b).workTapeSymbols
          (Fin.natAdd (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) (0 : Fin 1)) = some b
      simp [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, bufferTape]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    dsimp only
    change ((controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr (.inl
      ((({ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} :
        Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.last _)).getD false, false)))))) :
          Action (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State).apply _ = _
    rw [hsym, controlAction_apply]
    simp only [Option.getD_some, moveInputPos_zero]
    rfl
  change (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step
    ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c)) = _
  rw [hback, hread]

/-- A singleton-output decider reaches the selected branch's genuine
initial configuration in at most twice its budget plus five steps.
**Proof sketch.** Choose the first source halt, which is within the supplied
budget. Capture until that halt, read the singleton in two steps, and rewind
in at most the current input position plus two. The head-position bound
charges this rewind to the decider's elapsed steps, not the input length. -/
private lemma timed_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads b := by
  classical
  have hh : ∃ t, (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) t).state = none :=
    ⟨T, ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hD).1⟩
  let t := Nat.find hh
  let c := D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) t
  have ht : t ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hh ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hD).1
  have hs : c.state = none := Nat.find_spec hh
  have hc : D.ComputesInTime x c.output t := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩
  have ho : c.output = [b] := hc.output_unique hD
  have hcap : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c := by
    rw [timed_control_init]
    exact timed_capture D M₁ M₂ _ t (fun s hst => Nat.find_min hh hst)
  obtain ⟨r, hrle, hr⟩ := timed_rewind (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm
    (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, false)))) (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))))
    (some (.inr (.inr (.inr (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀))))
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl)
    (timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b) rfl
  refine ⟨t + 2 + r, ?_, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, ?_⟩
  · have hp : c.inputPos.val ≤ 1 + t := by
      simpa only [MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init, Fin.val_one] using
        MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound (tm := D.tm) (D.tm.initCfg x) t
    change r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2 at hrle
    omega
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcap,
      timed_read D M₁ M₂ c b hs ho, hr]
    rfl

/-- **The timed conditional's time**. If `D` computes the verdict `[p x]` within `T₀` and `M₁`, `M₂`
compute `f₁`, `f₂` within `T₁`, `T₂`, the timed conditional computes `if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x`
within `5·(T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)` steps; no monotonicity is needed, since the selected
branch runs on the same physical input.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `computesFunInTime_cond`, which `f2_cond_time` copies: the
captured decider run, the two-step verdict read and the input rewind take at most `2·T₀ + 5` steps
(the private `timed_start`; the input head has moved at most once per decider step), and the
selected branch then runs from its own initial configuration (`timed_branch_run`,
`branchTM_computes`). -/
theorem timedCondTM_computes {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
      (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The timed conditional's space**. If `D` outputs `[b]` on `x` within `T` steps, then at every
time `t` the conditional's space is at most `D`'s space at time `T`, plus the branch union's space
at time `t`, plus two cells for the capture tape.

**Proof sketch.** Catalog's `f2_cond_space`: the three tape groups are disjoint. The decider
bank is touched only during the captured run, which halts by `T`; the branch bank only after
the dispatch, along the branch union's own trajectory; the capture head stays in `{0, 1}`. The
ledger `f2_cond_ledger` (moved with it) gives the head positions of the three groups at every
time. -/
theorem timedCondTM_spaceUsed (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T t : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.spaceUsed ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T +
        (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t + 2 := by
  sorry

/-- **W3, the timed branch**: the quantitative form of
`Turing.FinTM.exists_cond`. If a decider machine computes the test bit
within `T₀` and each branch computes its function within `T₁`, `T₂`, the
conditional function is computable within a constant multiple of
`T₀ + max T₁ T₂ + 1`. No monotonicity hypothesis: the selected branch runs
on the *same* physical input.

**Proof sketch.** Run the decider through the W1 capture discipline (its
verdict on the capture tape, physical output silent), rewind per the
`Turing.FinTM.rewind_from_any` scan, then dispatch on the captured bit into
the two-machine branch union (`Turing.FinTM.branchTM`), which runs the
selected branch from its genuine initial configuration on the shared input.
Constant overhead per phase is absorbed into `c`. -/
theorem computesFunInTime_cond {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
        (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) := by
  refine ⟨timedCondTM D M₁ M₂, 5, fun x => ?_⟩
  let B := max (T₁ x.length) (T₂ x.length)
  have hb : (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).ComputesInTime x
      (if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) B := by
    apply (branchTM_computes M₁ M₂ (p x) x _ B).mpr
    cases hp : p x with
    | false => exact (h₂ x).mono (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
    | true => exact (h₁ x).mono (Nat.le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, tapes, heads, hstart⟩ :=
    timed_start D M₁ M₂ x (p x) (T₀ x.length) (hD x)
  have hc : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x
      (if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) (a + B) := by
    apply (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstart, timed_branch_run]
    obtain ⟨hs, ho⟩ := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hb
    exact ⟨by simpa only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hs, ho⟩
  -- The controller prefix and selected branch fit one uniform coefficient.
  apply hc.mono
  dsimp only [B] at *
  omega

end Turing.FinTM

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

set_option autoImplicit false

open Turing Turing.FinTM

namespace Gate117Consumers

attribute [local irreducible] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init
  Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed
  Turing.FinTM.bufferTape Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM Turing.FinTM.leftCfg
  Turing.FinTM.rightCfg Turing.captureCfg Turing.FinTM.branchTM Turing.FinTM.idTM
  Turing.FinTM.constTM Turing.FinTM.prependTM Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM

theorem coded_space (M : CodeTM) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    M.toFinTM.tm.spaceUsed (M.toFinTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
      M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t := by
  rw [CodeTM.toFinTM_eq]

theorem left_fields {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S')
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ) :
    (leftCfg f c tapes heads).state = c.state.map f ∧
    (leftCfg f c tapes heads).inputPos = c.inputPos ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin (k + l)) (a : ℤ), (leftCfg f c tapes heads).workTapes i a =
      Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) c.workTapes tapes i a) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin (k + l), (leftCfg f c tapes heads).workTapePos i =
      Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ) c.workTapePos heads i) ∧
    (leftCfg f c tapes heads).output = c.output := by
  exact ⟨leftCfg_state _ _ _ _, leftCfg_inputPos _ _ _ _,
    leftCfg_workTapes _ _ _ _, leftCfg_workTapePos _ _ _ _, leftCfg_output _ _ _ _⟩

theorem right_fields {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool} (f : S → S')
    (c : Cfg l Bool S x) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) :
    (rightCfg f c tapes heads).state = c.state.map f ∧
    (rightCfg f c tapes heads).inputPos = c.inputPos ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin (k + l)) (a : ℤ), (rightCfg f c tapes heads).workTapes i a =
      Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) tapes c.workTapes i a) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin (k + l), (rightCfg f c tapes heads).workTapePos i =
      Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ) heads c.workTapePos i) ∧
    (rightCfg f c tapes heads).output = c.output := by
  exact ⟨rightCfg_state _ _ _ _, rightCfg_inputPos _ _ _ _,
    rightCfg_workTapes _ _ _ _, rightCfg_workTapePos _ _ _ _, rightCfg_output _ _ _ _⟩

theorem capture_fields {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) :
    (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).state = some ((c.state.map emb).getD ret) ∧
    (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).inputPos = c.inputPos ∧
    (∀ i a, (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).workTapes i a =
      (if h : i.val < k then c.workTapes ⟨i.val, h⟩
        else bufferTape (pre ++ c.output)) a) ∧
    (∀ i, (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).workTapePos i =
      if h : i.val < k then c.workTapePos ⟨i.val, h⟩
      else ((pre ++ c.output).length : ℤ)) ∧
    (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).output = out₀ := by
  exact ⟨captureCfg_state _ _ _ _ _, captureCfg_inputPos _ _ _ _ _,
    captureCfg_workTapes _ _ _ _ _, captureCfg_workTapePos _ _ _ _ _,
    captureCfg_output _ _ _ _ _⟩

theorem zero_copy (x : List Bool) (t bound : ℕ) :
    idTM.tm.spaceUsed (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ bound := by
  rw [idTM_spaceUsed]
  exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem zero_const (w x : List Bool) (t bound : ℕ) :
    (constTM w).tm.spaceUsed ((constTM w).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ bound := by
  rw [constTM_spaceUsed]
  exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem zero_prepend (w x : List Bool) (t bound : ℕ) :
    (prependTM w).tm.spaceUsed ((prependTM w).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ bound := by
  rw [prependTM_spaceUsed]
  exact Nat.zero_le _

theorem zero_validator (x : List Bool) (t bound : ℕ) :
    pairValidTM.tm.spaceUsed (pairValidTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ bound := by
  rw [pairValidTM_spaceUsed]
  exact Nat.zero_le _

private def branchView (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) :
    MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
  rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
  exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm

theorem branch_views_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b b' : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x) (t : ℕ) :
    (branchView M₁ M₂ b).runFrom c t = (branchView M₁ M₂ b').runFrom c t := by
  exact branchTM_runFrom_independent M₁ M₂ b b' c t

-- Conditional on the actual host's fixed-table agreement; full condTM repair is outside scope.
theorem branch_conditional {d : ℕ} {HState : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool)
    (H : MultiTapeTM (d + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) Bool HState)
    (emb : (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) → HState)
    (htr : ∀ q inp work, H.tr (emb q) inp work =
      rightAction d emb ((branchView M₁ M₂ false).tr q inp
        (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd d i))))
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin d → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin d → ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    H.runFrom (rightCfg emb c tapes heads) t =
      rightCfg emb ((branchView M₁ M₂ b).runFrom c t) tapes heads := by
  have fixed := rightCfg_run (branchView M₁ M₂ false) H emb htr c tapes heads t
  exact fixed.trans (congrArg (fun z => rightCfg emb z tapes heads)
    (branch_views_run M₁ M₂ false b c t))

#print axioms coded_space
#print axioms left_fields
#print axioms right_fields
#print axioms capture_fields
#print axioms zero_copy
#print axioms zero_const
#print axioms zero_prepend
#print axioms zero_validator
#print axioms branch_views_run
#print axioms branch_conditional

end Gate117Consumers

    (leftCfg f c tapes heads).output = c.output := by

    (∀ i a, (rightCfg f c tapes heads).workTapes i a =
      (Fin.addCases tapes c.workTapes) i a) ∧
    (∀ i, (rightCfg f c tapes heads).workTapePos i =
      (Fin.addCases heads c.workTapePos) i) ∧
    (rightCfg f c tapes heads).output = c.output := by
  exact ⟨rightCfg_state _ _ _ _, rightCfg_inputPos _ _ _ _,
    rightCfg_workTapes _ _ _ _, rightCfg_workTapePos _ _ _ _, rightCfg_output _ _ _ _⟩

    captureCfg_output _ _ _ _ _⟩

## ===== campaign/gates/117-reading-api/review/compiled-seals/README.md =====

# Gate 117: compiled census, axioms, seals and consumers

Executed evidence for frozen PR head `1160c18f03fd318f0dec25738790935fa61379d4`, against
base `e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86`. The checks below pass in their stated
scopes. **Not yet clear to merge:** the external gate and the maintainer's replay/merge
decision are separate. This folder does not claim a global seal of legacy code or a
repair of the complete `condTM` consumer.

## Compiled population and axioms

`Census-base` and `Census-head` enumerate every constant owned by the five changed
modules, including internal/generated/private constants, with its full name, module,
kind and privacy flags. They filter only by owner module. The raw outputs and parsed
`census-{base,head}.json` are retained.

| Module suffix | Base | Head | Added |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `Encoding` | 175 | 176 | 1 |
| `Simulation` | 162 | 175 | 13 |
| `Composition` | 86 | 88 | 2 |
| `Build.Wrappers` | 80 | 85 | 5 |
| `Build.Primitives` | 1279 | 1281 | 2 |
| Total | 1782 | 1805 | 23 |

There are exactly **23 new public theorems**: eight explicit source declarations and
15 generated field readers. No constant is removed or changes its owner/kind/privacy
classification. The private population remains 1293. There is no additional new
internal/private/compiler auxiliary; the separate target-prefix auxiliary scan also
finds none. This conclusion comes from the unfiltered delta, not a target-name filter.

`Metadata-head-v2` walks axioms for all 23 actual new names, checks their simp membership,
prints their complete types, inventories referenced TCSlib definitions and their owners,
and dynamically inventories the imported default simp definitions/equations.

- Eight explicit theorems use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`.
- Ten Simulation field readers use only `propext`, `Quot.sound`.
- Five capture-field readers are axiom-free.
- All 23 are public, non-internal, and absent from both the simp-lemma and unfold sets.

No new theorem depends on `sorryAx` or a custom axiom. The five generated names in each
of the `leftCfg`, `rightCfg`, and `captureCfg` families are exactly `_state`, `_inputPos`,
`_workTapes`, `_workTapePos`, and `_output`. Their actual compiled types, including all
index/cell binders and capture universes, are in the metadata log.

## Owner-scoped strong seals

The direct foreign ordinary-definition inventory is:

| New theorem home | Foreign ordinary definitions in its new compiled types/proofs |
| --- | --- |
| Encoding | none |
| Simulation | `MultiTapeTM.runFrom` |
| Composition | `MultiTapeTM.initCfg`, `MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed` |
| Primitives | `MultiTapeTM.initCfg`, `MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed` |
| Wrappers | `FinTM.bufferTape` |

The actual default simp-definition inventory adds `Action.apply`, `Cfg.init`, and
`MultiTapeTM.initCfg`. No additional definition is exposed through an active `eq_*`
simp equation in this import closure.

All five `Owner-*-sealed` probes pass, exit 0 with zero errors. They are complete copies
of the exact frozen owner sources with guards around **only the nine new source
insertions**. Each guard seals the six-definition union above, except that Simulation's
same-home `bufferTape` is excluded there. It removes the three model definition-level
simp attributes while the new section elaborates, then restores those original attributes
before legacy code continues. `analyze.py` checks that removing only these guards recovers
the frozen source byte for byte. Source and guarded-copy hashes are recorded in
`owner-full-source-map.json` and `context.json`.

Same-home definitions may reduce in their own reader proofs. Legacy sections remain
unsealed, and their existing sorry/linter warnings are retained in the raw logs. Those
warnings are not a claim about the new APIs: the independent compiled axiom walks above
cover all 23 additions. Nothing here certifies the old implementations globally.

The remaining nine foreign definition references are reducible structure projections:
the five `Cfg` fields, `FinTM.k`, `FinTM.State`, `FinTM.tm`, and `MultiTapeTM.tr`. The metadata
classifies them as abbreviation hints. `Abbreviations-unsealable` actually attempts each
standard irreducibility attribute: exit 1, exactly nine rejections because they are
reducible. They fall under the policy/TEMPLATE abbreviation exception. No unsafe
reducibility or relaxed transparency option is used.

## Actual published consumers and controls

`Published-consumers-sealed-v2` passes using the actual head APIs, with all 16 relevant
ordinary definitions sealed **before** its headers and with the three model simp
attributes removed. It consumes every new API name:

- The actual `CodeTM.toFinTM_eq` transports the bundled space expression to the raw one.
- Three complete field-collection theorems consume all 15 actual generated readers.
- Four arbitrary-natural-bound space proofs use the actual zero-space equations.
- The actual branch shape/run equations support the explicit transported view and a
  conditional right-bank consumer. Its host-table-agreement premise remains explicit;
  no full legacy `condTM` repair is claimed.

All ten consumer theorem axiom walks are within the same standard sets; the capture
consumer is axiom-free. These probes do not replace the APIs with hypotheses.

The 16 consumer seals are listed in `control-definitions.txt`: the six model/default
definitions, the bundled/configuration/branch/four canonical-machine definitions, and
`rightAction`. The paired controls instantiate their actual compiled defining values.
For structure-valued results the point control projects a data field, so it differs
from the abstract whole-function equation even for nullary machines. Each positive
direct `Eq.refl` proof is installed as a theorem through the kernel's `addDecl`; a
failed proof is never admitted.

- Unsealed controls: exit 0, zero errors, exactly 32 distinct kernel-checked successes.
- Sealed controls: exit 1, exactly 32 labeled failures, one pointwise and one abstracted
  equation for each of the 16 definitions.

`check_controls.py` verifies exact identifier and diagnostic multiplicities, not merely
the total error count. Its own negative cases reject duplicate diagnostic identity
while preserving count, missing identity, an unexpected pass, and a zero negative exit.
See `control-check.json`. Every actual failed control goal is printed in the raw negative
log with its definition/mode identifier.

## Retained attempts and receipts

Three development attempts are retained and superseded:

1. `Metadata-head`: one printing error because `ReducibilityHints` has no `Repr`; v2
   prints its constructor classification explicitly.
2. `Owner-sections-sealed`: three errors because `simps` cannot modify imported
   declarations. The successful exact owner-source copies replace this attempted method.
3. `Published-consumers-sealed`: four header errors from partially applied
   `Fin.addCases` without an expected motive. v2 supplies the explicit motives. Failed
   attempt error-recovery axiom prints are not evidence about the published APIs.

All raw sources, outputs and per-run receipts are retained. `results.json` reconciles
all 15 runs, actual exits/errors, input/output hashes, full source recovery, 23-name
coverage and axiom/simp results. `analyze.py` and `check_controls.py` reproduce these
checks; `SHA256SUMS` covers this folder.

Every elaboration used only `devtools/seyoon/leanelab.sh`, one Lean process at a time,
shared slot locks/local budget three, against complete `oleans-mac3` or
`oleans-reading-preflight2` trees and the corresponding managed worktree. Copies named
`.lean` lived only in unique `/private/tmp/tcslib-gate117-seals-*` directories. No Git
operation mutated state; no actual source, snapshot, cache, screen, or reference was
changed by this review. The 394-module replay is separate maintainer evidence.

## ===== campaign/gates/117-reading-api/review/compiled-seals/analyze.py =====

```
"""Reconcile raw gate117 evidence, preserving every run and checking frozen inputs."""
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = out.parents[4]
scratch = Path(os.environ['TCSLIB_SCRATCH'])
base = 'e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86'
head = '1160c18f03fd318f0dec25738790935fa61379d4'
wt = scratch / 'wt-natbits'
for commit in (base, head):
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(wt), 'cat-file', '-e', commit + '^{commit}'], check=True)


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


census = {}
for side in ('base', 'head'):
    entries = {}
    for line in (out / ('Census-' + side + '.out')).read_text().splitlines():
        if not line.startswith('CONSTANT|'):
            continue
        _, name, owner, kind, internal, private = line.split('|')
        assert name not in entries
        entries[name] = dict(name=name, owner=owner, kind=kind,
                             internal=internal == 'true', private=private == 'true')
    census[side] = entries
added = set(census['head']) - set(census['base'])
removed = set(census['base']) - set(census['head'])
assert len(added) == 23 and not removed
assert all(census['base'][n] == census['head'][n] for n in set(census['base']) & set(census['head']))
assert all(census['head'][n]['kind'] == 'theorem' and not census['head'][n]['private']
           and not census['head'][n]['internal'] for n in added)
generated = {f'Turing.FinTM.{stem}_{field}' for stem in ('leftCfg', 'rightCfg')
             for field in ('state', 'inputPos', 'workTapes', 'workTapePos', 'output')}
generated |= {f'Turing.captureCfg_{field}' for field in
              ('state', 'inputPos', 'workTapes', 'workTapePos', 'output')}
assert generated <= added and len(generated) == 15

targets, axioms, defaults = {}, {}, []
foreign, abbreviations = defaultdict(set), set()
auxiliaries = []
lines = (out / 'Metadata-head-v2.out').read_text().splitlines()
for line in lines:
    parts = line.split('|')
    if line.startswith('TARGET|'):
        assert parts[1] not in targets
        targets[parts[1]] = parts
    elif line.startswith('AXIOMS|'):
        assert parts[1] not in axioms
        axioms[parts[1]] = [] if parts[2] == '[]' else parts[2][1:-1].split(', ')
    elif line.startswith('DEF|') and parts[4] == 'sameOwner=false':
        if parts[5] == 'hints=abbrev':
            abbreviations.add(parts[2])
        else:
            foreign[parts[1]].add(parts[2])
    elif line.startswith('SIMPDEF|'):
        defaults.append(parts[1])
    elif line.startswith('AUXILIARY|'):
        auxiliaries.append(line)
assert set(targets) == added == set(axioms)
assert all(t[3:] == ['private=false', 'internal=false', 'simp=false', 'unfold=false']
           for t in targets.values())
assert all(set(a) <= {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'} for a in axioms.values())
assert not auxiliaries
assert len(abbreviations) == 9
assert set(defaults) == {'Turing.Action.apply', 'Turing.Cfg.init', 'Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg'}
foreign_by_owner = defaultdict(set)
for name, defs in foreign.items():
    foreign_by_owner[targets[name][2]].update(defs)

additions = json.loads((root / 'campaign/gates/117-reading-api/evidence/additions.json').read_text())
context = dict(base=base, head=head, toolchain=(wt / 'lean-toolchain').read_text().strip(),
               sources={}, snapshots={}, owner_sources_recovered=True)
guard_map = json.loads((out / 'owner-full-source-map.json').read_text())
for row in guard_map:
    path = row['source']
    frozen = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(wt), 'show', head + ':' + path])
    assert (wt / path).read_bytes() == frozen
    assert sha(frozen) == row['source_sha256']
    copy = (out / (row['probe'] + '.lean.txt')).read_text()
    assert sha(copy.encode()) == row['guarded_sha256']
    recovered = re.sub(r'\nsection Gate117NewSection\d+\nattribute \[local irreducible\] [^\n]+\n'
                       r'attribute \[-simp\] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg\n',
                       '', copy)
    recovered = re.sub(r'\nend Gate117NewSection\d+\nattribute \[simp\] Turing.Action.apply '
                       r'Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg\n', '', recovered)
    assert recovered.encode() == frozen
    context['sources'][path] = dict(head_sha256=sha(frozen),
        head_blob=subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(wt), 'rev-parse', head + ':' + path], text=True).strip())
    for label, snapshot in [('base', 'oleans-mac3'), ('head', 'oleans-reading-preflight2')]:
        p = scratch / snapshot / path.replace('.lean', '.olean')
        context['snapshots'].setdefault(label, {})[str(p)] = dict(sha256=sha(p.read_bytes()), bytes=p.stat().st_size)
context['worktree_heads'] = {label: subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(scratch / tree), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
                            for label, tree in [('base', 'wt-camp'), ('head', 'wt-natbits')]}
(out / 'context.json').write_text(json.dumps(context, indent=2) + '\n')

expected = {'Metadata-head': (1, 1), 'Owner-sections-sealed': (1, 3),
            'Published-consumers-sealed': (1, 4), 'Controls-sealed': (1, 32),
            'Abbreviations-unsealable': (1, 9)}
runs = []
for receipt_path in sorted(out.glob('*-run.json')):
    stem = receipt_path.name.removesuffix('-run.json')
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    source = (out / (stem + '.lean.txt')).read_bytes()
    raw = (out / (stem + '.out')).read_bytes()
    assert sha(source) == receipt['input_sha256'] and sha(raw) == receipt['output_sha256']
    assert len(re.findall(rb'(?m)^.*:\d+:\d+: error:', raw)) == receipt['errors']
    assert (receipt['exit'], receipt['errors']) == expected.get(stem, (0, 0)), stem
    runs.append(dict(probe=stem, exit=receipt['exit'], errors=receipt['errors'],
                     input_output_hashes_match=True))
result = dict(base_constants=len(census['base']), head_constants=len(census['head']),
              added_public_theorems=len(added), generated_public_fields=len(generated),
              explicit_source_theorems=len(added - generated), removals=0,
              private_counts={side: sum(r['private'] for r in census[side].values()) for side in census},
              additional_compiler_auxiliaries=auxiliaries,
              axiom_sets=dict(Counter(str(a) for a in axioms.values())),
              all_23_public_non_simp=True,
              foreign_regular_by_target_owner={owner: sorted(names) for owner, names in foreign_by_owner.items()},
              default_simp_definitions=sorted(defaults), abbreviation_exclusions=sorted(abbreviations),
              runs=runs, all_recorded_outcomes_and_hashes_match=True)
(out / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
```

## ===== campaign/gates/117-reading-api/review/compiled-seals/argument-inspection.md =====

# New-section argument inspection

The approved source additions were read in the frozen five-file diff and checked again
against exact Git blobs before making the guarded copies. This inspection concerns only
the additions, not unchanged legacy tactics.

| Addition | New proof/command arguments |
| --- | --- |
| `CodeTM.toFinTM_eq` | `rfl`, reading its same-home definition; structure projections are reducible abbreviations. |
| Ten left/right field readers | Exact owner-local `simps` commands, explicit five projections, `isSimp := false`. |
| `branchTM_k`, `branchTM_State` | `rfl`, reading the same-home branch constructor. |
| `branchTM_runFrom_independent` | `rw` names only the published same-home shape equations and `MultiTapeTM.agreeOn_iff`; the run is transferred by the public `runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn`. Its inner `rfl` compares identical same-home tables. |
| Five capture field readers | Exact owner-local `simps` command with `isSimp := false`; the foreign `bufferTape` stays sealed in the successful owner probe. |
| Four zero-space facts | Exact application of the public `spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero`; the premise's `rfl` reads only the same-home canonical machine's tape count. |

No other-file TCSlib definition is supplied to a new `simp`, `rw`, `unfold`, `dsimp`,
`show`, or `change` argument. In particular, `runFrom`, `spaceUsed`, and `bufferTape` are
not unfolded by these additions. The only `simps` targets are the three owner-local
configuration definitions whose fields the user approved.

The successful published-consumer probe rewrites only actual API theorem names, or
uses the actual reader theorem directly. Its probe-local `branchView` may reduce; all
16 ordinary foreign definitions in its seal set remain irreducible. No production
consumer uses a foreign-definition `rfl` or passes such a definition to a tactic.

Definitions named in guard/attribute instrumentation and in the intentional negative
controls are part of the test mechanism, not production proof-unfolding arguments.

## ===== campaign/gates/117-reading-api/review/compiled-seals/check_controls.py =====

```
"""Check exact per-definition control multiplicities and exercise rejection cases."""
from collections import Counter
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
names = (out / 'control-definitions.txt').read_text().splitlines()
expected = {(name, mode) for name in names for mode in ('point', 'abstract')}


def check(positive, negative, positive_receipt, negative_receipt):
    for text, wanted in ((positive, 'PASS'), (negative, 'FAIL')):
        rows = [line.split('|') for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('CONTROL|')]
        counts = Counter((row[1], row[2]) for row in rows)
        assert counts == Counter({key: 1 for key in expected}), 'control multiplicity mismatch'
        assert all(row[3] == wanted for row in rows), 'unexpected control outcome'
        if wanted == 'PASS':
            assert all(len(row) == 5 and row[4].startswith('kernelChecked=') for row in rows)
            assert len({row[4] for row in rows}) == len(expected), 'duplicate kernel proof name'
    error_ids = Counter(re.findall(r'RFL_CONTROL\|([^|\n]+)\|(point|abstract)\|', negative))
    assert error_ids == Counter({key: 1 for key in expected}), 'diagnostic multiplicity mismatch'
    error_pattern = r'(?m)^.*:\d+:\d+: error:'
    assert len(re.findall(error_pattern, positive)) == 0
    assert len(re.findall(error_pattern, negative)) == len(expected)
    assert (positive_receipt['exit'], positive_receipt['errors']) == (0, 0)
    assert (negative_receipt['exit'], negative_receipt['errors']) == (1, len(expected))


positive = (out / 'Controls-unsealed.out').read_text()
negative = (out / 'Controls-sealed.out').read_text()
pr = json.loads((out / 'Controls-unsealed-run.json').read_text())
nr = json.loads((out / 'Controls-sealed-run.json').read_text())
check(positive, negative, pr, nr)
ids = re.findall(r'RFL_CONTROL\|[^|\n]+\|(?:point|abstract)\|', negative)
negative_cases = {}
cases = {
    'duplicate_diagnostic_identity_preserving_count':
        (negative.replace(ids[0], ids[1], 1), deepcopy(nr)),
    'missing_diagnostic_identity':
        (negative.replace(ids[0], 'REMOVED_DIAGNOSTIC|', 1), deepcopy(nr)),
    'unexpected_positive_outcome':
        (negative.replace('|point|FAIL', '|point|PASS', 1), deepcopy(nr)),
    'zero_negative_exit': (negative, {**nr, 'exit': 0}),
}
for name, (changed, receipt) in cases.items():
    try:
        check(positive, changed, pr, receipt)
    except AssertionError:
        negative_cases[name] = 'rejected'
    else:
        raise AssertionError('checker accepted invalid evidence: ' + name)
result = {
    'definitions': len(names),
    'pointwise_and_abstracted_pairs': len(expected),
    'positive_exit': pr['exit'],
    'negative_exit': nr['exit'],
    'negative_lean_diagnostics': nr['errors'],
    'all_exact_multiplicities_match': True,
    'checker_negative_cases': negative_cases,
}
(out / 'control-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
```

## ===== campaign/gates/117-reading-api/review/compiled-seals/run_probe.py =====

```
"""Run one already-reviewed probe via the managed elaborator; retain every attempt."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5]
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = out / sys.argv[1]
if source.parent != out or not source.name.endswith('.lean.txt'):
    raise SystemExit('probe must be a direct .lean.txt child of this output folder')
stem = source.name.removesuffix('.lean.txt')
log_path = out / (stem + '.out')
receipt_path = out / (stem + '-run.json')
if log_path.exists() or receipt_path.exists():
    raise SystemExit('refusing to overwrite an existing attempt')
data = source.read_bytes()
temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='tcslib-gate117-seals-', dir='/private/tmp'))
probe = temp_dir / (stem.replace('-', '_') + '.lean')
probe.write_bytes(data)
mode = sys.argv[2]
if mode not in ('base', 'head'):
    raise SystemExit('mode must be base or head')
snapshot = Path(os.environ['TCSLIB_SCRATCH']) / ('oleans-mac3' if mode == 'base' else 'oleans-reading-preflight2')
worktree = Path(os.environ['TCSLIB_SCRATCH']) / ('wt-camp' if mode == 'base' else 'wt-natbits')
wrapper = root / 'devtools/seyoon/leanelab.sh'
command = ['bash', str(wrapper), str(worktree), str(snapshot), str(probe)]
start = time.time()
completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
log_path.write_bytes(completed.stdout)
text = completed.stdout.decode(errors='replace')
receipt = {
    'command': command,
    'start_utc': datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(start, datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'seconds': time.time() - start,
    'input_sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
    'output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(completed.stdout).hexdigest(),
    'exit': completed.returncode,
    'errors': len(re.findall(r'(?m)^.*:\d+:\d+: error:', text)),
    'temporary_input': str(probe),
    'snapshot': str(snapshot),
    'base': 'e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86',
    'head': '1160c18f03fd318f0dec25738790935fa61379d4',
    'mode': mode,
}
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
if len(text) <= 8000:
    print(text)
else:
    print('Raw output retained:', str(log_path), 'bytes=', len(completed.stdout))
```

## ===== campaign/gates/117-reading-api/review/source-screen/REVIEW.md =====

# Gate 117: independent source, lint, copy screen and reuse search

Reviewer: Codex maintainer subagent `/root/review_mig1_brief`. This is a bounded pre-dispatch review; it does not close gate 117 or certify a replay.

**Result: no blocker, major or minor source change requested.** The proposed source matches the 23 approved API additions. No surviving source is changed, no new copy pair appears, and the fresh branch/delivery source search finds no competing exact source declaration or configuration-field generation site.

## Pins and scope

- Base: `e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86`.
- PR 230 head: `1160c18f03fd318f0dec25738790935fa61379d4`.
- Approval: `campaign/gates/117-reading-api/user-ruling.json`, all 23 scopes. Earlier proposal documents that called readers unapproved are historical, not the current ruling.
- Exact archives: `archives/base.tar` and `archives/head.tar`; eight inert extracted `.lean.txt` files on each side. Full commit/tree/blob pins and SHA256 receipts are in `source-pins.json`.

The five changed homes are Encoding, Simulation, Composition, Build/Wrappers and Build/Primitives. The full copy-screen population additionally contains Configuration, Deterministic and Finite. `POPULATION.md` and `population.txt` fixed that population before execution. The metadata reviewer independently confirmed those eight cover the foreign definition/model homes reached by the proposed API and published-consumer probes; Simulation also owns bufferTape and the agreement theorem. Neither population nor pair output is capped.

## Source recovery and exact approval scope

Removing only the approved insertion text from each fresh head file recovers the entire corresponding base file **byte for byte**. Thus all surviving declarations, private helpers, headers, visibility, order, imports, executable definitions and old proof bodies remain unchanged. The independent comment-aware source census agrees: eight explicit public theorem additions; no public removal, private addition/removal, visibility change, or surviving definition/proof/header change. The raw byte check is stronger than that parser's header classification.

| Home | Explicit source additions | Generated field additions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Encoding | `CodeTM.toFinTM_eq` | 0 |
| Simulation | `branchTM_k`, `branchTM_State`, `branchTM_runFrom_independent` | Five fields each for `leftCfg`, `rightCfg` |
| Composition | `idTM_spaceUsed`, `constTM_spaceUsed` | 0 |
| Build/Primitives | `prependTM_spaceUsed`, `pairValidTM_spaceUsed` | 0 |
| Build/Wrappers | 0 | Five fields for `captureCfg` |

All field families are the approved `state`, `inputPos`, `workTapes`, `workTapePos`, `output`. The only three added simps commands specify `isSimp := false` and fully qualified definition names. There are no new imports, public definitions, or source `[simp]` attributes. The explicit-source census is 198 to 206 public declarations and 270 to 270 private declarations over the changed homes. This source count excludes compiler-generated field theorems and generated auxiliary declarations. Their exact names, attributes and axioms must be read from the separate compiled metadata receipt, not inferred from this source count.

## Mathematical and documentation review

1. **Coded bundle equation.** The whole constructor equality exposes precisely the existing one-tape count, finite state type and underlying machine, with no changed code interpretation or computation/space claim. Its same-home reflexive proof reads the definition it owns. The existing `CodeTM.toFinTM_k` remains available unchanged.
2. **Configuration readers.** `leftCfg` and `rightCfg` retain arbitrary tape/frame/head data and their existing sum embeddings; the readers are unconditional field equations for those configurations. The capture readers preserve the distinction between the physical output `out₀` and the buffered word `pre ++ c.output`. In particular, state uses the return-state fallback, the extra capture tape stores that buffered word, and its head is at the buffered length. These are readers for the definitions, not stronger run simulation claims.
3. **Branch API.** The tape-count and state-type equalities reveal only the common sum carriers. `branchTM_runFrom_independent` compares runs from one fixed common configuration after explicit transport into those carriers. It does not compare the machines' different native initial configurations. Its proof reuses the existing public `runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn` with the universal agreement set; same-home transition agreement is reflexive because the Boolean changes only the native initial-state selection. It is placed after the published agreement API, so there is no forward-reference dependency. The complete statement and proof were inspected manually: the generic source parser stops at the statement's type-level `let view :=` and does not itself recover that whole header.
4. **Four exact zero-space facts.** They hold for every input and every time, including time zero and after halting. They specialize the public zero-tape space theorem to the existing zero-tape canonical machines. They do not require their separate computation-specification theorems, including any inherited admitted theorem. Reading each canonical machine's own tape count occurs in its own home, not a foreign consumer.
5. **Documentation and boundaries.** The new docstrings describe these operational contracts and the branch transport. The short proof bodies introduce no new policy-lint finding. Old module/long-file/proof-sketch findings are preserved and reported below; this review neither repairs them nor records a new debt acknowledgment. The published-probe/reducibility/axiom checks are separate sibling evidence. No Lean was executed in this review.

## Lint: actual before/head runs

Canonical lint implementations were read and executed unchanged through their functions, with the root redirected to each inert archive and exactly the five changed homes supplied. Logs retain `.lean.txt` labels.

| `campaign_style_lint.py`, check 8b enabled | 0 FAIL / 8 WARN / 8 INFO, exit 0 | 0 FAIL / 7 WARN / 8 INFO, exit 0 | Field-reader coverage improves; no new warning family |

The unchanged style findings include inherited oversized files, old proof sketches/module sections, and the linter's old prose false positives `lemma (source` / `axiom axiom:`. The campaign linter drops Encoding's missing toFinTM field-equation warning and removes leftCfg/rightCfg/captureCfg from existing missing-reader lists. It still reports unrelated existing missing-reader and size findings. Changes in whole-file line counts are additions at the approved homes, not evidence that a size warning disappeared. Logs, script hashes and normalized comparison are under `lint/` and `source-and-lint.json`.

## Copy screen: actual complete runs and candidate disposition

The unchanged `copy-text-screen-v3.py` ran serially under `$TCSLIB_SCRATCH/locks/screen`, with `nice -n 10`, on all eight full archived files on each side. Both runs exited zero and the lock was released; timestamps, complete commands and raw-log hashes are in `screen/receipt.json`.
